annotation.bound_parties_text: The proposed Regulation incorporates obligations for manufacturers, importers and distributors, and sets requirements for national authorities responsible for notified bodies, leaving designation and monitoring to Member States.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: The proposal incorporates obligations for manufacturers, importers and distributors to be aligned with the NLF Decision 768/2008/EC.
annotation.dates_quote: The proposed Regulation will become applicable 30 months after its entry into force to allow manufacturers, notified bodies and Member States time to adapt to the new requirements.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: Section 3 on offset risks due to the mobility of machinery has been adapted to address the risks on autonomous machines and remote supervisory stations.
